name: The sea organ
desc: Waves play the organ: sea-driven pipes tuned to tones. The best sound-object on the coast.

name: Wind in the rigging
desc: A working north-easterly worrying the masts and halyards in the marina — the same voice the bura has in Senj.
credit: “Yachts in the wind I - Marina Kornati Biograd na Moru” — recorded by zybil (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2020-11-10 at 43.94N 15.44E.

name: Tide between the rocks
desc: Sea tides bubbling in and out between limestone rocks in a small village cove, recorded summer 2025.
credit: “bubbly field-recording of the sea tides in between rocks - recorded with ZOOM H1 Handyrecorder - in okrug, croatia” — recorded by artsybadboi (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2025-10-10 at 43.49N 16.29E.

name: Bells and cicadas in Betina
desc: A lazy summer afternoon: church bells over the harbor and cicadas in the stone pine shade.
credit: “Church bells and ambience in Betina.wav” — recorded by Satoration (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2008-07-31 at 43.83N 15.60E.

name: Old-town murmur with gulls
desc: Soundscape of the old town Starigrad on Pag after sunset: sheep, crickets, birds, seagulls, people.
credit: “Pag_Starigrad_sheep_crickets_birds_seagull_ppl.wav” — recorded by dkustic (Freesound), CC-BY 3.0. Recorded 2008-08-02 at 44.43N 15.06E.

name: Evening on the promenade
desc: Around 6 p.m. in the Lapad district: evening town ambience as the day cools off.
credit: “importanne hotel ambience_dubrovnik_050516.WAV” — recorded by miastodzwiekow (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2016-05-12 at 42.66N 18.06E.

name: Island channel ambience
desc: Boat life in the Brijuni channel off the Istrian coast: engines, water, gulls.
credit: “Brijuni Ambiance” — recorded by VlatkoBlazek (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2015-07-31 at 44.92N 13.77E.

name: Open-sea swell
desc: Small waves breaking close to the microphone in the open south Adriatic — nothing but water and wind.
credit: “Waves” — recorded by Loredenii (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2025-04-28 at 42.65N 14.04E.

name: Old town at dusk
desc: Recorded between 5 and 7 p.m. on the Walls of Dubrovnik's Old Town: the city exhaling after the day.
credit: “old grad ambience_dubrovnik_070516.WAV” — recorded by miastodzwiekow (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2016-05-14 at 42.64N 18.11E.

name: Ferry with gulls aboard
desc: A car ferry crossing the Kvarner channel: deck rumble, seagulls and people, recorded on board.
credit: “CarFerrySeaDogsPeople.wav” — recorded by dkustic (Freesound), CC-BY 3.0. Recorded 2008-08-02 at 44.60N 14.97E.

name: Crickets at night
desc: Full-summer night soundfield in the forest on the hill above the village of Dramalj.
credit: “dramalj_croatia__on_the_hill_above_the_village.flac” — recorded by Nonoo (Freesound), CC-BY 3.0. Recorded 2007-06-27 at 45.20N 14.67E.

name: Cicadas in the pines
desc: Cicada orni singing from a vacation on the island of Brač, Croatia, 2013.
credit: “Cicada orni” — recorded by VlatkoBlazek (Freesound), CC-BY 4.0. Recorded 2015-02-02 at 43.27N 16.63E.
